title: Reaction
description: One row of the toolkit table (Section 5). Reactions are the unit of mastery tracking. Questions reference reactions by id; the engine never hard-codes chemistry.

chapter.description: Chapter toggle: the settings screen can switch chapter 17 off.

phase.description: Build phase in which the reaction ships.

reagentsText.description: Reagents/conditions exactly as written in the toolkit table.

steps.description: Canonical route: ordered steps, each a set of bottles plus conditions.

altRoutes.description: Other routes graded as fully correct (e.g. H2O vs H3O+ workup).

stereoOutcome.description: What the stereo picker should expect by default when the reaction creates stereocenters.

smarts.description: Reaction SMARTS used ONLY by the validator to reproduce answers from starting materials. Omit for reactions that cannot be templated (naming, acidity).

rxn.description: RDKit reaction SMARTS. Ring-opening products must be written as one grouped component: >>([C:1]=O.[C:2]=O).

reactants.description: Reactant order for RunReactants: 'start' for the starting material, 'step:N' for the first reagent in route step N that has a smiles field, otherwise a reagent id that has a smiles field.

mode.description: single: any one product set may match. exhaustive: apply until no site is left (NaBH4 reduces every ketone).

decoys.description: Reagent ids that should sit on the shelf as decoys when this reaction is asked.

typicalTags.description: Mistake tags this reaction usually produces; used to pick decoys and to seed the clinic.

minigames.description: Technique minigames run for this reaction (defaults come from the bottles; this overrides).

smartsMode.description: alternatives (default): any one template's product set may equal the answer. pipeline: templates are applied in order to the starting material; 'exhaustive' templates apply 0..n times, 'single' templates must apply exactly once; the final product must equal the answer.

reagents.description: Bottle ids added in this step, or '#class' tokens matching any reagent that lists that class (reaction definitions only; item routes always name real bottles). Order within a step does not matter; order of steps does.

conditions.description: Conditions the player must set in the minigames for this step. Absent means 'not graded'.

light.description: true: light/peroxide ON is required; false: it must be OFF (plain HBr + alcohol trap).

equiv.description: Required equivalents on the pour gauge (1 vs 2 for H2O2).

pressure.description: Kolbe CO2 gauge must be pumped up.
